dolphin_shopkeeper.text: Welcome to the Dolphin Gifts. Fungie the dolphin lived in Dingle harbour from 1983, and boats took visitors out to see him for nearly forty years.
He swam off in 2020, and the town still waves at the harbour. A bottlenose dolphin can live forty years or more.
Dolphins sleep with half the brain at a time, so the other half keeps them swimming. I wish I could do that on a Monday.
